3. Run `node scripts/export-models.mjs girl` (writes assets/models/rainbow_girl.glb + docs/characters/girl_turntable.png: front / three-quarter / side / back). Do not accept "sort of similar".
4. `docs/characters/girl.md`: joints, clips, materials, tri count, identity checklist status, known gaps (honest).

Final report (short): files, GLB size, tris, clip list, what matches, what differs, shared-file change requests.
